# verify d6 B-rule details and test analog
o6=objs2(D6i,3,8)

import itertools
def touches_only(gi,bg,obj):
    others=[o for o in objs2(gi,bg,8) if o[1]!=obj[1]]
    t=[o for o in others if any((a+da,b+db) in set(o[1]) for a,b in obj[1] for da in (-1,0,1) for db in (-1,0,1))]

    if len(o[1])==1: print('d6 singleton',o[1][0],'touches:',[(x[0],len(x[1])) for x in touches_only(D6i,3,o)])
# test: singleton (20,19) and its touched object

sing=[o for o in oT if len(o[1])==1]
print('test singletons:',[(o[0],o[1][0]) for o in sing])
for o in oT:
    if (20,19) in o[1]: big=o
print('(20,19) obj:',big[0],len(big[1]),'touches:',[(x[0],len(x[1]),x[1][0]) for x in touches_only(T,6,big)])

def group_stats(gi, bg, ref_color):
    os_ = objs2(gi, bg, 8)
    ref = [o for o in os_ if o[0]==ref_color]
    refc = (sum(c[0] for c in ref[0][1])/len(ref[0][1]), sum(c[1] for c in ref[0][1])/len(ref[0][1])) if ref else None
    # rotation-invariant groups
    from collections import defaultdict
    shapes=defaultdict(list)
    for o in os_:
        shapes[variants2(o[1])].append(o)
    res=[]
    for k,v in shapes.items():
        if len(v)>1:
            ds=[min(((a-refc[0])**2+(b-refc[1])**2)**.5 for a,b in [ (sum(c[0] for c in o[1])/len(o[1]), sum(c[1] for c in o[1])/len(o[1]))][0:1]) for o in v]
            mean_d=sum(ds)/len(ds)
            # farthest member by centroid
            far=max(v,key=lambda o:((sum(c[0] for c in o[1])/len(o[1])-refc[0])**2+(sum(c[1] for c in o[1])/len(o[1])-refc[1])**2))
            res.append((len(v), len(v[0][1]), round(mean_d,2), far[1][0], [o[1][0] for o in v]))
    return sorted(res,key=lambda r:r[2])
